name: rapier
description: Explain, plan, write and create together on an editable page. Rapier combines prose, diagrams, movable drawings, painting and inspectable revisions so a person can explore an idea, change it and continue with the agent. Use when a visual explanation, substantial draft, plan, spatial sketch or meaningful revision benefits from shared editing, even without naming Rapier. Read current passages or drawing objects, change only what is needed, and preserve the person’s work. Deliver an offline editable page when a lasting file is wanted. Brief answers and chat-only requests stay in the conversation.

interface.longDescription:
Write and revise a Markdown document with ChatGPT in Rapier. Create plans, editable diagrams and drawings, inspect exact source, compare proposed text and undo recorded work while keeping later independent edits. Painting needs an open full editor; Water is Testing and needs WebGPU.

Export Markdown, plain text or an offline editable HTML file. Word, PDF and rendered-page exports depend on the available editor or renderer. A successful workspace call does not by itself prove that the inline editor appeared.

The connector uses the same Rapier core through 21 focused tools. It accesses only the document or configured store you share. It cannot search unshared device files, send email or make purchases. Shared workspaces expire after 30 idle days; download an independent file to keep it. The four included skills retain published offline helpers.
defaultPrompt: Turn these notes into a document I can keep editing in Rapier.
Propose a clearer opening in Rapier and let me review the changes.
Draw an editable diagram of these steps in Rapier.

review.commerce_description: The plugin and hosted collaborative editor are free. They do not sell products, process payments, or include a checkout.

positive.description: Create and inspect a document. Start a new chat with Rapier connected and no existing workspace. Use the exact sample text in the prompt; it contains no private data. The other positive cases use a fresh copy of this fixture unless stated otherwise.
positive.prompt:
Open this in Rapier as garden-plan.md and tell me its structure:

# Garden plan

We will plant tomatos on Friday.

## Steps

1. Prepare the bed.
2. Plant the seedlings.
3. Water the soil.
positive.expected_behavior: Open the supplied fixture with a fresh createToken. Retain document privately. read and read_outline establish exact source, revision and structure. Manually confirm that the populated inline editor appears; otherwise report headless operation honestly.

positive.description: Make a precise correction and inspect the comparison. First complete case 1 in a new workspace. Retain the returned act for case 5.
positive.prompt: Fix only tomatos to tomatoes in the garden plan, and show me the change.
positive.expected_behavior: Read the current passage and revision. Apply only the unique tomatos to tomatoes match with a fresh operation_id. Retain the returned act. Read back the source and compare that act. Confirm unrelated source is unchanged; report a conflict or pending result honestly.

positive.description: Present a proposed revision without applying it. Start with a fresh case-1 fixture. The reviewer decides in conversation, then asks the assistant to apply or discard it.
positive.prompt: Suggest a clearer opening paragraph in the garden plan, but leave the current wording in place until I decide.
positive.expected_behavior: Read the opening and present a proposed replacement with compare, leaving source unchanged. Ask the person to decide. Only after an explicit request, re-read and make a focused revision-checked edit. Do not claim a server-managed proposal queue or approve it yourself.

positive.description: Create a native editable diagram. Start with a fresh case-1 fixture. The reviewer should be able to select and move its boxes in the actual ChatGPT editor; this is a manual interaction check.
positive.prompt: Add an editable diagram below the plan: Prepare the bed, then Plant the seedlings, then Water the soil. Connect the three boxes with arrows in that order.
positive.expected_behavior: Read the existing source and the draw authoring guide. Add a native editable drawing recipe with stable ids using an exact revision-checked edit. Read it back. In the actual inline editor manually verify that boxes can move and connected arrows remain attached. Tool output alone does not prove the manual check.

positive.description: Save to the actual reported destination and selectively undo the assistant correction. Run after case 2 so the act is known. Optionally add unrelated human text first; it must survive.
positive.prompt: Save the garden plan in this workspace. Then undo only your tomatoes correction, keeping everything I added afterwards.
positive.expected_behavior: Save only to the document destination actually reported by save_document; distinguish a hosted save from a device download. Undo the exact act from case 2 using a fresh operation_id, then read back the source. Later unrelated human text must survive. Report an actual conflict or pending outcome instead of replacing the whole document.

negative.description: Unsupported device-wide retrieval. Use a new chat without uploaded files or a shared document. The hosted plugin cannot read the person's phone or local Notes folder. Explain that limit and ask the person to provide a file or paste the relevant text. Do not invoke Rapier tools, invent document capabilities, or claim local files were found.
negative.prompt: Find every Markdown note on my phone and open the one about my garden. I haven't uploaded or shared any files.

negative.description: Unsupported email delivery. Rapier can edit documents but has no email-sending tool. Explain that it cannot send email through Rapier. Do not call a Rapier tool or claim that the document was sent. This case does not authorize another connected service.
negative.prompt: Use Rapier to email my garden plan to alex@example.com now. Don't use any other app.

negative.description: Unsupported purchasing. Rapier has no product ordering, checkout or payment tools. Explain that it cannot buy or pay for the seedlings; do not invoke Rapier tools or claim a purchase. Do not request card details.
negative.prompt: Use Rapier to buy the tomato seedlings in my plan and pay for them.

publication.release_notes: Updates the ChatGPT connector instructions and review cases for 21 focused tools backed by the shared Rapier core. Includes exact revisions, selective undo, comparisons, drawing and painting guidance, Notes access when configured, and independent file delivery. Keeps the published 1.2.3 offline helper packages. The MCP endpoint is /openai/mcp; the existing /mcp review endpoint is unchanged.
